title: Monthly income-to-poverty position and job count move on different clocks
source_unit: identified SIPP person record across adjacent reference months, with monthly fields and first-month person weight

denominator.unit: valid adjacent person-month pairs for THINCPOV; 346,283 available adjacent pairs before field-specific missingness

income_to_poverty_band_change.unit: percent of valid THINCPOV adjacent pairs

job_count_band_change.unit: percent of valid RMNUMJOBS adjacent pairs; valid-pair denominator 297,861

identified_persons.unit: identified people in selected SIPP slice

persons_with_all_12_months.unit: identified people with all twelve reference months

observations.method: Adjacent-month person comparison using key SSUID + SHHADID + PNUM, first-month WPFINWGT, THINCPOV bands below 1x/1–2x/2–4x/4x-or-more poverty, and monthly RMNUMJOBS categories. Separate valid-pair universes are retained.
observations.uncertainty: Descriptive weighted transition shares without Fay–BRR or other design-based variance in this diagnostic. The two change shares have different valid-pair denominators and are not a formal relative-volatility comparison.
observations.subgroup: All identified SIPP persons with valid adjacent values for the relevant monthly field; no household-weighted estimate.
observations.counterinterpretation: A stable job-count category can coexist with an income-band change through earnings, hours, transfers, household resources, or other components; a job-count change can occur without an income-band change. Neither field observes schedule control, job quality, or cause.

related_sources.claim: The official dictionary defines THINCPOV and RMNUMJOBS as monthly/reference-month fields and documents their universes.
The official 240-replicate archive remains available for a later design-based variance pass.
The reproduction audit preserves the local derived-input hash, row counts, fields, and no-variance boundary.

boundary: This is a same-person monthly descriptive diagnostic from the 2025 SIPP public-use file for the 2024 reference year. It does not establish causality, household-weighted volatility, exact bill or care events, hours, pay, schedule control, health, trust, political action, or geopolitical consequence. Annual/reference-period hardship fields appearing on monthly rows are not promoted into this monthly event measure.
